title: GetZep: Weighted Label Propagation Communities, Per-Group Sequential Queues & Typed Ontology Builder
summary: Graphiti detects entity communities via edge-count weighted label_propagation (candidate_rank > 1 promotion with max tie-breaking) and serializes per-group episode mutations through isolated asyncio.Queue workers in QueueService. Zep Python's build_ontology() compiles EntityModel and EdgeModel declarations into typed wire payloads (text, int, float, boolean), enforcing non-empty docstrings/descriptions, Identity markers restricted to entities, and Excluded field omissions.

references.description: Edge-weighted synchronous label_propagation community detection and summarize_pair
Per-group_id sequential asyncio.Queue episode ingestion worker isolation
build_ontology compiling PropertyType (text/int/float/boolean), Identity, and Excluded annotations

author: repo-triad-forge
distilled_learning: Cluster entities with edge-weighted label propagation, serialize mutations per group_id via dedicated queues, and compile typed entity/edge ontologies with explicit identity and exclusion guards.
